title: Emergency department evaluation
description: Presented with dizziness, polyuria, and home glucose readings above 280 mg/dL. Discharged with urgent diabetes follow-up.

title: Endocrinology follow-up
description: Medication review, dietary counseling, and repeat labs ordered for glycemic control and kidney monitoring.

title: COPD exacerbation admission
description: Admitted for wheezing and oxygen saturation 88 percent on room air. Improved after nebulizers, steroids, and antibiotics.

title: Primary care review
description: Fatigue and exertional shortness of breath. CBC and iron studies reviewed; oral iron plan discussed.

title: Heart failure decompensation
description: Admitted for dyspnea, edema, and elevated BNP. Diuresed with improvement and cardiology follow-up arranged.

title: Postpartum thyroid check
description: Palpitations improving. Thyroid labs reviewed and repeat TSH planned in six weeks.
